Taswira · Beyond the monuments

42 seconds · 1920×1080 · 60 fps · silent prototype. Press Play, then use the player's full-screen button.

A directed Great Zimbabwe sequence: hill, enclosures, passage, domestic spaces and a pullback. Original Zomo artwork accompanies the map. Architectural arrangements and counts are schematic; this is an unreviewed draft.

Captions and transcript
WEBVTT

1
00:00:00.000 --> 00:00:05.000
What makes a city? Look beyond its most famous tower.

2
00:00:05.000 --> 00:00:11.000
Above the settlement, stone enclosures and terraces follow the granite hill.

3
00:00:11.000 --> 00:00:17.000
Below it, the Great Enclosure reveals the skill of its stone builders.

4
00:00:17.000 --> 00:00:23.000
An inner wall creates a narrow passage toward the conical tower.

5
00:00:23.000 --> 00:00:28.000
Around these monuments were spaces for living, including dhaka houses and granaries.

6
00:00:28.000 --> 00:00:32.000
A city was more than its monuments. People made it a place to live.
